prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: shoulder injury. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1235; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was traveling in the ordinary course when your insured's vehicle crossed into the client's lane and struck it head-on. Although the impact occurred at low speed, the force was sufficient to cause significant injury to our client's right shoulder, which has required ongoing medical evaluation, physical therapy, and restrictions on lifting and overhead work.

The available evidence points to your insured's sole negligence. The responding officer's report reflects that your insured acknowledged losing focus on the road, and no comparative fault can reasonably be assigned to our client, who was driving lawfully and attentively.

Our client has incurred substantial medical expenses, lost wages from time away from work, and continuing pain and loss of enjoyment of daily life. We have enclosed the treatment records, billing statements, and wage documentation that support these damages.

To resolve this matter without litigation, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] within thirty days of the date of this letter. This demand is made under the applicable policy limits and reflects a good-faith effort to settle. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are authorized to file suit without further notice.

Please direct all communications regarding this claim to our office.
